target: Chinese course research article; Nature-informed graphics, not a Nature submission
core_claim: High minimum-denominator location repeatability can coexist with substantial loss of source locations.

figure1.question: Where are the retained centers in two synchronized F50 views?
figure1.scope: 2 representative F50 images, chosen before this revision; F200 results remain fully represented in quantitative Figure2

figure2.question: How do repeatability and source retention respond under the same controlled conditions?
figure2.n: 4 images, 2 views x 2 moments from one recording
figure2.spread: all four observations shown; no inferential interval

figure3.question: Why can the Harris rotation45 case have high r but low source retention?
figure3.selection: existing diagnosed EGO F200 rotation45 case; not a representative population estimate

image_integrity.response_only: recomputed Harris response for display, per-image log-positive normalization, magma pseudocolour
image_integrity.rotation_case: recorded H applied in memory to original JPEG; no reloading lossy transformed JPEG
image_integrity.point_overlay: all saved centers relevant to the specified panel; no aesthetic subsampling

limitations: Four related images do not establish generalization
Position matching is not descriptor matching or tracking
No statistical tests, seeds, confidence intervals, new independent sessions, or new model results
